name: chat
title: Chat
description: The foundation for genuicn cards: a json-render chat (Fluid Functionalism UI, Vercel AI SDK, AI Gateway) with its API route and a /chat page. Install once, then add cards.
docs: Add your Vercel AI Gateway key to .env.local as AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (Vercel dashboard > AI Gateway > API Keys), then open /chat. Install cards next, e.g. npx shadcn@latest add <site>/r/quote.json.
